rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the crime of breaking in to steal.

example.english: There have been more burglary incidents in this area lately, so remember to lock your doors and windows at night.
example.traditional: 呢區最近爆竊多咗，大家夜晚記得鎖好門窗。
example.jyutping: ni1 keoi1 zeoi3 gan6 baau3 sit3 do1 zo2 daai6 gaa1 je6 maan5 gei3 dak1 so2 hou2 mun4 coeng1

rows.note: Use this when referring to a particular reported burglary case or incident.

example.english: Police say that particular burglary case is still under investigation.
example.traditional: 警方話，嗰宗爆竊案仲喺度調查。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 waa6 go2 zung1 baau3 sit3 on3 zung6 hai2 dou6 tiu4 caa4
